posts.text:
Hey Chris French, you're such an amazing tutor. Thank you for this.
I highly recommend Data Cleaning with Claude

Congratulations, Mrs. Abimbola Arowolo.

God bless your new home. Amen
I'm excited to begin a new role as a Data Analyst at Indorama Eleme Fertilizers and Chemical Limited.

Our Excel Bootcamp Just Ended,  SQL Is Next.

We just wrapped up our Data Analysis with Excel class, and I couldn’t be prouder of our students in this bootcamp.

Over the past few weeks, we’ve learned and practiced together in our live sessions, taking things slow, asking questions, making mistakes, and growing through it all. It’s been amazing to see how much confidence they’ve gained in working with data.

A huge shoutout to Abimbola Arowolo and the Techsavia team for organizing this scholarship bootcamp and creating such a supportive space for learners to grow. 
It’s truly inspiring to be part of this journey as an instructor.

By the weekend, our students will be presenting their projects before we move on to the next tool, SQL. 
Exciting times ahead!
